checksums.name: header_zero_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: 16-bit wrapping sum (FUN_0803c1e0) of the 16-byte header as 8 words; writer stores two's-complement negation at offset 0x0E so the whole record sums to 0 mod 65536. In .sav file space words must be read big-endian (serial MSB-first EEPROM packing in FUN_08049f8c/FUN_0804a050 byte-swaps each RAM word); little-endian file-space sum is 0x01FE on both samples and is falsified. Repair: stored_BE = (-sum(BE words with checksum zeroed)) & 0xFFFF at 0x0E.

checksums.name: global_record_zero_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_0803c1e0 primitive over the 40-byte global record (20 words, EEPROM blocks 2-6); FUN_0803c29c stores -sum at record offset 0x26 (file 0x36, RAM struct+0x36); FUN_0803c2e0 validates sum==0. Both samples are all-zero so byte verification is trivial; formula is code-proven.

checksums.name: slot_zero_sum16_unresolved_length
checksums.formula_detail: FUN_0803c0a8 computes FUN_0803c1e0(*(save_struct+0x38), _DAT_0803c0d8) and stores (sum==0) at save_struct+0x60+slot*4. The length literal _DAT_0803c0d8 is not resolved in the workspace. Candidate A full 2712-byte slot: BE sum on blank samples = 0xFABC (invalid, consistent with empty-slot handling in FUN_0803bc08). Candidate B 16-byte head only: sum = 0x0000 (trivially valid, all-zero head). Cannot be decided with blank slots only.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 engine: programs DMA src/dst/count (count|0x80000000 enable) via literal-pool regs (0x040000D4 family), spins on busy bit 0x8000; used for both directions to/from 0x0D000000
EEPROM read 8 bytes (1 block): MSB-first command+address bitstream to 0x0D000000, then 0x44 halfwords back (64 data + 4 dummy bits), reassembles 4xu16 MSB-first
EEPROM write 8 bytes (1 block): serialises 4xu16 + address MSB-first (stream length addr_bits+0x43), DMA to 0x0D000000, polls data line with 0x88-tick timeout for write-cycle completion
Verify: read-back via 0x08049f8c, compares 4xi16, returns 0x8000 on mismatch else 0
Write wrapper: forwards to 0x0804a050 unless device-type word == 0x200
Write+verify with up to 3 retries per 8-byte block; caller edge from decompiled.c:5008 (missing in callgraph.json)
Multi-block read: bus setup 0x0803c378, loop 0x08049f8c stepping block++/ptr+=8, bus restore 0x0803c3a8
Multi-block write: bus setup 0x0803c378, loop 0x0804a280 stepping block++/ptr+=8, bus restore 0x0803c3a8
Checksum primitive: i16 wrapping sum of (byte_len>>1) signed 16-bit words; also inlined as open loops in 0x0803c204/0x0803c244/0x0803c29c/0x0803c2e0
EEPROM bus setup: saves WAITCNT-family state and calls 0x08049ec4(0x40) to select EEPROM wait-state timing (WAITCNT 0x04000204 family)
EEPROM bus restore after block transfer
Header validate: read blocks 0-1, zero-sum over 8 words, then 8-byte magic compare; returns 1 valid / 0 invalid
Global record validate: read blocks 2-6 (40B), returns sum==0 over 20 words
Slot validate: FUN_0803c1e0 over slot RAM buffer with unresolved length literal; stores (sum==0) at save_struct+0x60+slot*4
Slot read: FUN_0803c318(339*slot+7, 339, *(save_struct+0x38)); stride 339 blocks proven by .sav islands 0x38/0xAD0/0x1568 and 56+3*2712=8192
Format header: memcpy 16B template (0x0802c4bc), sum 8 words, store -sum at word 7 (byte 0x0E), write blocks 0-1

Header sync: read EEPROM header, recompute RAM canonical checksum (+0xE zeroed, sum, negate), 4xu32 compare, rewrite blocks 0-1 on mismatch (returns 1); no caller recovered in callgraph.json or decompiled bodies
Write global record: memcpy 40B template, store -sum at struct+0x36 (record offset 0x26), write blocks 2-6 from struct+0x10
Zeroes slot RAM buffer *(save_struct+0x38) via memset 0x0802c450 before slot-head format writes (RAM only; EEPROM erase does not exist)

EEPROM device-struct literals (block count at struct+4, address-bit count at struct+8) behind _DAT_08049fa4/_DAT_0804a038 etc. are unresolved; 1024-block geometry is proven by the .sav partition arithmetic, not by reading those literals

Word order within an 8-byte EEPROM block in file space cannot be distinguished by the additive checksum; only the big-endian word-sum identity is verified. A populated sample with known RAM values would be needed to pin intra-block ordering
